slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 一根生锈的铁棍，一把看起来平平无奇的木剑，还有一颗铁叶草。
这三样东西，放在平时，雷震看都不会多看一眼。
毕竟，这只是些初级武魂，觉醒的先天魂力，在1-3级区间。
虽说能够修炼，但一辈子能成魂宗，魂王就算烧高香了！
可现在，到他手里，就不一样了！
这些东西，代表的是第二武魂，是进入封号斗罗境界的敲门砖。
“我选剑！
老夫这辈子修的就是剑，木剑也是剑！”
雷震在心里疯狂呐喊，意识猛地触碰向那柄木剑。
嗡！
议事大厅内，原本笼罩在雷震身上的黄光瞬间收敛，紧接着，一抹淡灰色的光影在他背后一闪而逝。
雷震猛地睁开双眼，右手下意识往虚空中一抓。
一柄长约三尺、通体由槐木削成般的木剑，赫然出现在他掌心。
就在木剑成型的一刹那，雷震浑身的气息有些变了。
对，是魂力变了！
虽然依旧还是八十九级，但总归是动了一丝！
雷震呆呆地感受着体内奔腾不息的魂力，老泪纵横。
“动了……动了！
老夫的魂力，居然真的动了！”
“只要再为这剑附加魂环，凭借魂环的提升......”
“我成封号斗罗，真的有望了！”
雷震顿时顾不得什么形象，转过身对着宁天就要跪下去，被宁天手疾眼快一把扶住。
“雷长老，您这是干啥？折寿啊。”
雷震声音沙哑，带着压抑不住的狂喜。
“少主！
再造之恩，雷震没齿难忘，没齿难忘啊！”
宁风致看着这一幕，也是难掩激动。
原本已经走到头的一名魂斗罗，现在硬生生被拔高了上限。
尘心看着雷震手里的木剑，虽然也同样看不上这武魂的品质，但其代表的意义太重了。
“风致，事不宜迟。”
尘心站起身，背后的七杀剑发出一声清脆的鸣响，
“雷震现在差的就是魂环，你的第八魂环也还没有吸收。”
“我这就带你和他去落日森林，或者星斗大森林。”
“以他的身体强度，这第二个武魂的第一魂环，起步也得是万年，多来一两个，就成封号斗罗了！”
“哎哎哎，几位爷爷，爹，先别急着走啊。”
宁天见几人兴冲冲的拔脚就走，连忙开口。
content_en:
A rusty iron rod, an ordinary-looking wooden sword, and an iron leaf grass.
Normally, Lei Zhen would not even look at these three things.
After all, these are just elementary martial souls, and the awakened innate soul power is in the 1-3 level range.
Although you can practice, if you can become a soul sect in your lifetime, the soul king will be considered a high incense!
But now, in his hands, it's different!
These things represent the second martial spirit and are stepping stones to enter the realm of Titled Douluo.
"I choose the sword!
I have been practicing swords all my life, and wooden swords are also swords! "
Lei Zhen screamed crazily in his heart, and his consciousness suddenly touched the wooden sword.
Buzz!
In the meeting hall, the yellow light that originally shrouded Lei Zhen's body instantly converged, and then, a light gray shadow flashed behind him.
Lei Zhen opened his eyes suddenly and subconsciously grabbed the void with his right hand.
A wooden sword about three feet long and made of locust wood suddenly appeared in his palm.
The moment the wooden sword took shape, Lei Zhen's aura changed somewhat.
Yes, the soul power has changed!
Although it is still level 89, it has moved a little bit!
Lei Zhen felt the endless soul power in his body and burst into tears.
“It’s moving… it’s moving!
My soul power actually moved! "
"As long as I add a soul ring to this sword, with the improvement of the soul ring..."
"I have a real chance of becoming a Titled Douluo!"
Lei Zhen suddenly didn't care about his image, turned around to face Ning Tian and was about to kneel down, but Ning Tian quickly held him up with his quick hands and eyes.
"Elder Lei, what are you doing? Losing your life."
Lei Zhen's voice was hoarse, filled with irrepressible ecstasy.
"Young Master!
The kindness of reinvention will be unforgettable by Lei Zhen! "
Ning Fengzhi couldn't hide his excitement when he saw this scene.
A Contra who had already reached his end was now forced to have his upper limit raised.
Chen Xin looked at the wooden sword in Lei Zhen's hand. Although he also looked down upon the quality of this martial spirit, the meaning it represented was too important.
“Fengzhi, it’s not too late.”
Chen Xin stood up, and the Seven Killing Sword behind him made a clear sound.
"What Lei Zhen is missing now is his soul ring. Your eighth soul ring has not been absorbed yet."
"I will take you and him to the Sunset Forest or the Star Forest."
"With his physical strength, the first soul ring of this second martial soul will have to be ten thousand years old at first. With one or two more, he will become a titled Douluo!"
"Hey, hey, grandpas, dad, don't leave in a hurry yet."
Ning Tian saw several people leaving happily and spoke quickly.
